messages.content: Compile the CURRENT public rule task into the seven-field structured program required by the response schema: scopes, clauses, rule_residuals, observations, bindings, nodes, query. Only local condition_code, value_code, otherwise_code and nodes[].code fields use restricted Python expressions. The expressions are parsed into a data-only source-linked DAG, never run as Python. Do not solve the task or emit a native answer beside the program. No tools or grading information are available. Expression strings contain one expression, not assignments or declarations. No imports, attributes, loops, functions, comprehensions, arbitrary calls, mutation or reassignment. Internal names are unique ASCII identifiers of at most64 characters. A name has no implicit semantic meaning. Write executable scope and clause records first. query uses the native-result AST schema, such as {"var":"named_clause"}; it is not a code string or a declaration. Inside expression strings keep parentheses balanced and use Python True/False/None. Outside strings use ordinary JSON true/false/null. There are no contradiction(), entailment() or other answer functions; native labels are quoted strings selected by executable guarded rules. join_on takes TWO declared relations and a params dictionary; project_exists takes ONE relation. A quoted sN ID or empty string is never a graph input. Do not enumerate every sentence into bindings. Declare only literal inputs and required predicates, then write executable rule expressions and guarded clauses; reuse named definitions. Primitive inputs are bindings records {name,type,sources,value}, with the actual typed shapes in language_contract. Never construct inputs or declarations inside expression strings. Provenance fields use the exact sN unit IDs, never task_id or arbitrary IDs. Every numeric value and public string must be grounded in those units. A relation contains actual factual witnesses, one cell per column, citing all required factual lines. Source IDs are provenance metadata, never relation cells or conclusions. Boolean primitive values require literal true/false in the cited text; paragraph numbers, years and 0/1 are not truth values. Factual predicates are observations records {name:b_NAME,entity:QUOTE,entity_source:FACT_ID, predicate:QUOTE,predicate_source:RULE_ID}. Both quotes must be exact source substrings; you do not provide their truth values in the program. Reuse the same observation for identical quotes. Legal effects, thresholds, arithmetic, dates and comparisons belong in expressions, not observations. Missing legal/numeric subexpressions are rule_residuals records {name:b_NAME,source:RULE_ID,quote:EXACT_SUBQUOTE}. These retain both False/True and are never sent to the factual observer. A residual must be a proper subexpression actually read by its containing clause or scope. Never replace an entire untranslated rule, final claim or numerical comparison with a fact predicate or guessed Boolean. Local calculations are nodes records {name,kind:"expression",code:EXPRESSION_STRING}. They do not discharge rule coverage. Scope records contain {name,source:ONE_RULE_ID,condition_code:BOOLEAN_EXPRESSION_STRING}. Only a nonconditional structural title may use literal True. Scope conditions are executable, not policy strings. All required_scope_sources must have scopes, including conditional prefaces. Rule output clauses contain {name,sources:[OWNED_RULE_IDS],value_code:EXPRESSION_STRING,otherwise_code:EXPRESSION_STRING}. The engine physically guards each clause with all inherited scopes from the transitive source context. State the disabled value explicitly: False, 0, [], or None as appropriate. Do not guess it. Own only the rule units actually translated. A constant citation or unused scope does not cover a whole rule. Translate other supplied rules even if irrelevant to this query; leave genuinely untranslated units unowned so they retain unknown scope. Expressions: names, literal integers/strings/True/False/None, and/or/not, ==/!=/</<=, +/-, literal_integer * numeric_expression, numeric_expression / nonzero_literal_integer, (then_value if Boolean_condition else else_value), arrays [...], and dictionaries {string_key:expression}. Helper functions: add, sub, min, max, xor, eq, ne, lt, le, scale, divide_constant, ceil_divide_constant, number_at, array, pair, object, concat, all_of, any_of. They implement the same typed operations, not arbitrary Python; all branches must type check. all_of() and any_of() take separate Boolean arguments: all_of(b_left, b_right), never all_of([b_left, b_right]). A list is not a Boolean. Empty or single-Boolean calls are supported. ceil_divide_constant(numeric, positive_literal_denominator) implements an increment or fraction thereof exactly; apply statutory bounds explicitly. Numeric vectors support vector[nonnegative_literal_index]; out-of-range access fails, with no default. A denominator 100 for percent or 2 for one-half is only the stated unit conversion, not a new factual amount. Connector nodes use kind:"connector" and code calling the seven operators from language_contract with explicit params dictionaries. Projections are identity, amount_value, amount_values and entailment_label. Named results or nested calls are allowed inside expressions. When an available learned graph matches actual slot and column obligations, invoke learned(pattern=HASH, variant=INDEX, slots={...}, columns={...}); copying its operators independently is not library use. Do not insert irrelevant calls to claim reuse. All consumption of one allowance bank must share one thread_allowance result; never clone or re-consume its bank. Read its different outputs from the one amount_values result. Each expression or graph has at most16 nested operators; factor longer ones into named nodes. The final query combines guarded CLAUSE outputs and public inputs into the native result in language_contract.query_result_schema; do not bypass guards via local helper/scope names. Do not return a constant native result. Source identifiers are not operands. Do not invent laws, witnesses, dates or constants. A quoted timing policy is not an executable date comparison; use supported numeric comparisons or preserve proper unknown subexpressions. accepted_program, when supplied, is the previously accepted structured translation; preserve unchanged primitive names and quotes to retain factual evidence. validation_feedback is source-only compiler diagnosis, never target answers; repair concrete errors without coercion or invented rules.  Compilation policy: answer_separating. Interface policy: collision_refined.
